AgencySettings.title: AgencySettings
AgencySettings.description: Global agency branding settings (agency name, tagline, and PNG logo data URL) shown across client presentations.

agencyName.description: Display name of the social media agency

agencyTagline.description: Short subtitle shown in presentation headers and PDF footer

agencyLogoDataUrl.description: Compressed PNG/WebP data URL for the agency logo

ownerId.description: UID of the agency admin who owns this configuration

ClientReport.title: ClientReport
ClientReport.description: Social media performance report for a client covering a specific month or custom date interval across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.

clientKey.description: Normalized client slug grouping multiple monthly or custom date-interval reports for the same client

clientIndustry.description: Industry or category of the client

startDate.description: Interval start date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format

endDate.description: Interval end date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (must be >= startDate)

period.description: Human-readable period label (e.g. Noviembre 2026 or 01 Nov – 15 Nov 2026)

currency.description: Currency used in the investment simulator

executiveSummary.description: Executive summary shown in the consolidated dashboard

clientLogoDataUrl.description: Compressed PNG/WebP data URL for the client logo

isPublished.description: Whether the report is publicly visible via presentation link and Google Sites embed

facebook.description: Facebook KPIs (reach, engagement, visits, followers), content mix, and up to 2 featured posts

instagram.description: Instagram KPIs (reach, engagement, visits, followers), content mix, and up to 2 featured posts

tiktok.description: TikTok KPIs (views, likes, visits, newFollowers), content mix, and up to 2 featured posts

simulatorDefaults.description: Default paid media simulator budget, objective, allocation shares, and CPMs

ownerId.description: UID of the agency admin who created the report

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Explicit admin allowlist document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/agencySettings/{settingsId}.description: Global agency brand configuration (doc id: default). Publicly readable for presentations; writable only by verified agency admin.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Client social media performance reports. Published reports are publicly readable for client presentations and Google Sites embeds; all writes restricted to verified agency admin.

/admins/{userId}.description: Admin UID allowlist. Only readable by the authenticated user for their own UID; client writes forbidden.
